Third-party components in this folder
-------------------------------------
- wasm/vision_wasm_internal.{js,wasm}: MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.2.3 runtime (npm package @mediapipe/tasks-vision), Apache License 2.0.
- face_landmarker.task: MediaPipe Face Landmarker model bundle (float16, v1) downloaded from Google's mediapipe-models storage.
  License of the model weights/data must be confirmed from the official model card before commercial production use (see CLAUDE.md, section 9).
Apache License 2.0 text: LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt
